Public uint256 array in DogeGender storing indices classified as dam.
Public uint256 cursor tracking the next index to be generated.
Private owner address in Ownable, set in constructor and checked by onlyOwner.
Private address declared in Ownable and never used in this code.
onlyOwner function that generates stud/dam classifications in a loop using pseudo-randomness.
External view function returning the stud array.
External view function returning the dam array.
Internal view function in Context returning msg.sender as address payable.
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to address(0).
Constructor of DogeGender, empty body, inherits Ownable constructor.
Constructor of Ownable that sets _owner from _msgSender().

msg.sender, attacker controllable caller identity used for ownership checks.
block.timestamp, miner/validator influenceable value used as randomness seed.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender, propagating the untrusted caller identity.
Ownable constructor assigns the _msgSender() result into local msgSender.
Caller-derived msgSender is written into _owner, establishing the access-control state.
Ownable constructor calls _msgSender() to obtain the deployer address.
onlyOwner compares _owner with _msgSender(), so msg.sender gates privileged functions.
renounceOwnership clears _owner to address(0), modifying the access-control state.
block.timestamp feeds the keccak256 seed, making the outcome timestamp dependent.
keccak256 randomness digest is stored in local hashOfRandom.
hashOfRandom is cast to uint256 as numberRepresentation.
Loop counter i is packed into the keccak256 randomness input.
Parameter length is summed with currentIndex to compute the loop end.
currentIndex is summed with length in unchecked 0.6 arithmetic.
Result of currentIndex + length is assigned to local endIndex.
endIndex bounds the generation loop inside generate().
Loop counter i drives the for-loop control flow in generate().
Parity of numberRepresentation decides whether an index goes to stud or dam.
generate() pushes indices into the stud state array.
generate() pushes indices into the dam state array.
generate() advances currentIndex to endIndex.
generate() consumes the length parameter to size the batch.
StudList reads and returns the stud state array.
DamList reads and returns the dam state array.

normalization_plan.reason: length is a generate() parameter that only scopes the loop bound, so it collapses into the generate function node.
endIndex is a temporary loop boundary local inside generate() and carries no standalone security meaning.
loop_i exists only as the generate() loop counter and should be folded into the generate function node.
hashOfRandom is the direct result of the keccak256 randomness unsafe operation and merges into it.
numberRepresentation is only the uint256 cast of the same randomness digest, so it belongs to the unsafe randomness operation.
msgSender is a constructor-local alias of _msgSender() and folds into the Ownable constructor node.
